desc: Examine the SELinux Policy and generate a process transition report
r: sepolicy-transition - Examine the SELinux Policy and generate a process transition report

sepolicy transition will show all domains that a given SELinux source domain can transition to, including the entrypoint.

If a target domain is given, sepolicy transition will examine policy for all transition paths from the source domain to the target domain, and will list the paths.

-h, --help
Display help message
-s, --source
Specify the source SELinux domain type
-t, --target
Specify the target SELinux domain type

List all domain transition paths from init_t to httpd_t
# sepolicy transition -s init_t -t httpd_t
List all transitions available from samba domain, including entry points and booleans controlling each transition
# sepolicy transition -s smbd_t
